answer: By binding each agent identity to a real-time capital collateral lock sized to its order flow toxicity, the protocol makes a sybil cluster costly to sustain across the willow-thin liquidity ridge of the book. Honest market makers forge reputation through non-linear margin haircuts that shrink as verified settlement history accumulates, so cloned identities inherit no. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
